annotation.title_clean: Stakeholder Consultation on UNESCO AI Readiness Assessment Held Today
annotation.title_en: Stakeholder Consultation on UNESCO AI Readiness Assessment Held Today
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Ministry of Communication, Digital Technology and Innovations, Ghana
annotation.venue: Ministry of Communication, Digital Technology and Innovations (Ghana) website
named_instruments_referenced: UNESCO Recommendation on the Ethics of AI
annotation.summary_en: Ghana's communications ministry news item on a 11 March 2026 stakeholder consultation validating the UNESCO AI Readiness Assessment Methodology. Findings note Ghana lacks binding AI-specific regulation and comprehensive data governance frameworks. Input will feed the national AI readiness report and governance recommendations.
key_provisions_or_claims: Consultation validated Ghana's UNESCO AI-RAM draft report with academia.
Assessment covers policy, institutional capacity, digital infrastructure, data governance and ethical safeguards.
Ghana currently lacks binding AI-specific regulations and comprehensive data governance frameworks.
Inputs will shape national AI readiness report and governance recommendations.
